explanation: A lexical noun detector: the pole fires on the word-final token of a noun or noun-like name, in prose or code (script, plan, budget, requests, bidding, timer, error.log, newDataObject, numbers, values), on multi-digit numerals (089, 378, 375), and on the concessive ' despite'/' spite' and the noun phrase right after it. Its strength depends on the noun (document, plan and quantity nouns such as script/plan/budget/requests reach about 0.5-0.7 of max; everyday nouns such as cat, chair and car often stay below 0.25), and it stays near zero on verbs, pronouns, determiners, most prepositions (during, with, before) and most adjectives, so text built only from pronouns, verbs, adjectives and function words is predicted inactive, while text with several content nouns is predicted active.
